trait.blurb: Every blow arcs to a second foe.

extreme.name: Baal Bolg: Judgement of Thunder
extreme.blurb: Nine bolts fall in a ring around you, one after another, each marked on the ground first.

trait.blurb: Your blade melts guard: foes burn and lose Resistance.

extreme.name: Amon Salos: Crown of the Sun
extreme.blurb: A sun blooms over you and bursts outward in one white-hot wave.

trait.blurb: Cold water clings: foes slow to a crawl.

extreme.name: Vinea Zalg: The Drowning Sea
extreme.blurb: A wall of sea rolls out from you, shoving everything before it.

trait.blurb: Each blow throws the foe back on a gust.

extreme.name: Focalor Zaleph: Seven-Wind Cyclone
extreme.blurb: A cyclone gathers round you, drags foes in and flings them skyward.

trait.blurb: A share of every blow flows back into you.

extreme.name: Zagan Genesis: Bloom of Life
extreme.blurb: A garden opens round you: allies are healed, foes are drained.

trait.blurb: Heavy blows: the more armour, the harder they land.

extreme.name: Zepar Fang: Titan's Fall
extreme.blurb: You leap, and come down with the weight of a giant.

trait.blurb: Blows ring in the skull: foes are silenced and dizzied.

extreme.name: Furfur Requiem: Chord of Ruin
extreme.blurb: Three rising chords roll out and shake everything in earshot.

trait.blurb: Foes are branded: set alight and lit up for the hunt.

extreme.name: Marchosias Hunt: Emberfang Run
extreme.blurb: You become a streak of fire and run a straight line through everything in it.

trait.blurb: Light bites: twice as hard against the undead.

extreme.name: Sitri Dawn: Radiance of First Light
extreme.blurb: The sky whitens and a second dawn breaks over you.

trait.blurb: A held breath of stillness after each blow.

extreme.name: Bifron Skyfall: Pillars of Storm
extreme.blurb: Eight pillars of storm light rise from the ground, each marked before it strikes.

trait.blurb: Wind-thin cuts that keep bleeding.

extreme.name: Paimon Tempest: Heavenly Gale
extreme.blurb: The sky itself closes round you and spins everything near into the air.

trait.blurb: Foes choke on the deep: their breath is taken.

extreme.name: Vassago Maelstrom: Abyssal Tide
extreme.blurb: A black whirlpool opens at your feet and drags the world towards it.

trait.blurb: A king's blow: the foe is driven to its knees and pinned.

extreme.name: Bael Thronus: Edict of the First King
extreme.blurb: Three shockwaves roll out from your throne, each one lifting and crushing everything it passes.

acts.name: Royal Decree
acts.desc: A cone of royal command in front of you: foes are hurt, slowed and driven to their knees.

acts.name: Throne Quake
acts.desc: The ground heaves round you: foes are hurt, thrown up, weakened and slowed.

trait.blurb: Tide-jaws: each blow drags the foe in towards you.

extreme.name: Agares Maw: Jaws of the Rising Tide
extreme.blurb: A wall of water shaped like a crocodile's jaws rears in front of you and snaps shut.

acts.name: Tidal Lunge
acts.desc: Lunges forward on a rushing tide: foes in the path are hurt, shoved and slowed.

acts.name: Undertow
acts.desc: A pulling current drags every foe near you in and holds them, hurt and slowed.

trait.blurb: A thief's blow strips the foe's boons and lends you their speed.

extreme.name: Valefor Larceny: Storm-Heart Heist
extreme.blurb: Fourteen stolen sparks of storm fall one after another, each marked on the ground first.

acts.name: Spark Snatch
acts.desc: Lightning snatches at the nearest foe and hops on to more, weakening each.

acts.name: Storm Heist
acts.desc: A dash in a flash of lightning: foes in the path are hurt and slowed, and you are left quick.

trait.blurb: The hunter's mark: wounded prey (below half health) takes half again as much.

extreme.name: Barbatos Venatio: The Wild Hunt
extreme.blurb: Eight pillars of living thorn burst out of the ground, each marked before it strikes.

acts.name: Wild Arrow
acts.desc: A shaft of green light along your gaze strikes the first two foes and poisons them.

acts.name: Green Ambush
acts.desc: Marks up to three foes (else ahead): thorned roots burst up a moment later, pinning and poisoning.

trait.blurb: A glimpse ahead: the foe is revealed and you take less from the next blow.

extreme.name: Gusion Speculum: Verdict of the Tide Mirror
extreme.blurb: Four lances of mirrored water cut out from you in a cross.

acts.name: Mirror Thrust
acts.desc: A thrust of mirrored water along your gaze hits up to three foes and reveals them.

acts.name: Tide Mirror
acts.desc: A mirror of water closes round you: Resistance and Absorption for you, and the foes near you are hurt and pushed back.

trait.blurb: Wrecker's blow: the foe's armour is cracked and worn down.

extreme.name: Vepar Naufragium: Wrecker's Surge
extreme.blurb: A surge of splintered hulls and cold black water rolls out from you.

acts.name: Anchor Drop
acts.desc: Brings the anchor down: a shock round you hurts foes, throws them up and cracks their guard.

acts.name: Shipwreck
acts.desc: A wall of wrecked tide: foes in a broad band ahead are hurt, shoved back and slowed.

trait.blurb: A dove's hush: the foe is silenced, slowed and forgets whom it was fighting.

extreme.name: Shax Silentium: Hush of the White Dove
extreme.blurb: A white silence spreads from you in one soundless wave.

acts.name: Wing Hush
acts.desc: A cone of white feathers: foes are hurt, silenced and thrown back.

acts.name: Muted Flurry
acts.desc: A silent storm of feathers round you: foes near you are hurt, silenced and dizzied.

trait.blurb: Each blow mends you and the allies beside you.

extreme.name: Buer Rota: The Wheel of Mending
extreme.blurb: A turning wheel of green light heals your allies and drains your foes.

acts.name: Wheel Mend
acts.desc: A turning wheel of light: you and your allies near you are healed, foes are hurt and weakened.

acts.name: Cleansing Spokes
acts.desc: Spokes of green light cleanse every ailment from you and your allies and heal them, while the foes in reach are hurt and slowed.

trait.blurb: A starburst: the foe is blinded and the foes round it are lit up.

extreme.name: Andrealphus Pavo: Fall of a Hundred Stars
extreme.blurb: Stars fall around you one after another, each marked on the ground first.

acts.name: Star Spear
acts.desc: A needle of starlight along your gaze strikes the first two foes and dazzles them.

acts.name: Peacock Fan
acts.desc: A fan of a hundred eyes opens before you: foes are hurt, blinded and lit up.

trait.blurb: Momentum: the faster you run, the harder the blow lands.

extreme.name: Kimaris Equus: Charge of the Dark Steed
extreme.blurb: You ride a straight line of black fire through everything in front of you.

acts.name: Charge Lance
acts.desc: A mounted charge: you dash forward, and every foe in the path is hurt and flung aside.

acts.name: Dark Gallop
acts.desc: A long gallop that tramples everything in its way and leaves you fast.

trait.blurb: The note rings outward: foes round the target are shoved back.

extreme.name: Amdusias Concerto: The Unicorn's Last Chord
extreme.blurb: Four notes ring out from you in a cross and meet in the air.

acts.name: Horn Note
acts.desc: A single piercing note along your gaze hits up to three foes and dizzies them.

acts.name: Grand Chord
acts.desc: A grand chord rings outward: foes near you are hurt, shoved far back and silenced.

trait.blurb: Cinders spread: the fire leaps to foes near the target.

extreme.name: Belial Inanis: Fall of the Hollow Throne
extreme.blurb: The air is dragged in towards you, and a moment later the hollow collapses in fire.

acts.name: Hollow Cleave
acts.desc: A hollow cleaving arc: foes are hurt, set alight and weakened.

acts.name: Throne Ash
acts.desc: A burst of black ash: foes near you are hurt, burned and blinded.

trait.blurb: Star-shell: every blow adds a little Absorption (to three hearts).

extreme.name: Decarabia Astra: Star-Shell Nova
extreme.blurb: A star ripens in a shell of light round you, then bursts.

acts.name: Pincer Snap
acts.desc: The pincers snap shut on foes right ahead: they are hurt and held fast.

acts.name: Star Shell
acts.desc: A shell of stars closes round you: a great deal of Absorption and Resistance for you, and the foes near you are hurt and dazzled.

trait.blurb: Each blow quickens you: Speed II for two seconds.

extreme.name: Seere Celer: Passage of the Swift Wind
extreme.blurb: You become the wind and pass in one breath through everything in a long line.

acts.name: Swift Slash
acts.desc: A flash of a dash that cuts everything in its path and leaves you quick.

acts.name: Gale Step
acts.desc: A long step on the wind that cuts every foe on its way and leaves you moving fast.

trait.blurb: Many faces: a confused creature turns on its nearest neighbour.

extreme.name: Dantalion Facies: Lecture of a Thousand Faces
extreme.blurb: Eight pillars of pale light rise, each with a face in it, each marked before it speaks.

acts.name: Forbidden Page
acts.desc: A page of forbidden script flies along your gaze, striking the first two foes with dizziness and weakness.

acts.name: Many Faces
acts.desc: Marks up to three foes (else ahead): a face of light looks up from each place a moment later, hurting and confusing.

trait.blurb: Hidden things are found: invisibility is stripped, and the hidden take half again.

extreme.name: Andromalius Inquisitio: Thunder Finds the Hidden
extreme.blurb: Nine bolts fall in a ring around you, one after another, each marked on the ground first.

acts.name: Seeker Bolt
acts.desc: A bolt that finds what hides: it strikes up to three foes along your gaze, who are lit up.

acts.name: Unveil
acts.desc: A flash of storm light over the area: foes near you are hurt, lit up and stripped of invisibility.

trait.blurb: Slaughter: each blow in a row bites harder, up to forty percent more.

extreme.name: Glasya-Labolas Cruor: The Slaughter Howl
extreme.blurb: A howl and a rush of claws tear through a wide fan in front of you.

acts.name: Savage Rend
acts.desc: Savage claws: foes right ahead are hurt and bleed.

acts.name: Bloodhound Rush
acts.desc: A hound's rush: foes in the path are hurt and bleed, and a share comes back to you as health.

trait.blurb: Alchemy: the blow turns to a random boon for you and a random bane for the foe.

extreme.name: Haagenti Opus: The Great Work
extreme.blurb: A cauldron of gold-bronze wind turns round you and throws everything in it into the air.

acts.name: Bull Gore
acts.desc: A gore: you charge a few blocks, hurting and flinging the foes in the path.

acts.name: Great Work
acts.desc: The Great Work: a burst round you hurts, poisons and weakens foes, and mends you with regeneration.

trait.blurb: Rime spreads: cold clings to every foe near the target.

extreme.name: Crocell Glacies: The Sage's Frozen Tide
extreme.blurb: A tide of ice-water rolls out from you and freezes where it stops.

acts.name: Frost Bolt
acts.desc: A bolt of cold along your gaze strikes the first two foes, freezing and slowing them.

acts.name: Rime Field
acts.desc: A field of rime spreads round you: foes near you are hurt, frozen and slowed.

name: Furcas
title: Old Knight of the Ice Wind

trait.blurb: An ice wind throws the foe back and chills it.

extreme.name: Furcas Boreas: Charge of the Ice Wind
extreme.blurb: A knight's charge on an ice wind sweeps a wide fan in front of you.

acts.name: Ice-Wind Sweep
acts.desc: A sweeping ice wind: a broad cone of foes is hurt, frozen and thrown back.

acts.name: Knight's Gale
acts.desc: A knight's charge on an ice wind: foes in the path are hurt, chilled and flung aside.

trait.blurb: Three heads, three bites: two foes near the target take a share too.

extreme.name: Balam Trias: Prophecy of Three Flames
extreme.blurb: Eight pillars of foretold flame rise from the ground, each marked before it strikes.

acts.name: Triple Flame
acts.desc: Three tongues of flame leap from foe to foe, setting each alight.

acts.name: Prophecy
acts.desc: Foretells three places (on your foes, else ahead): fire falls on each a moment later.

trait.blurb: The lion's roar weakens every foe near you.

extreme.name: Alloces Leonis: The Lion's Judgement
extreme.blurb: A golden roar breaks over everything near you.

acts.name: Lion Slash
acts.desc: Three clean claw-strokes of fire: foes in the cone are hurt and burn.

acts.name: Lion's Roar
acts.desc: A lion's roar: foes near you are hurt, weakened and filled with fear.

trait.blurb: The crows pick at the weak: a foe with any ailment takes half again as much.

extreme.name: Camio Corvus: A Murder of Crows
extreme.blurb: Crows dive around you one after another, each marked on the ground first.

acts.name: Crow Flock
acts.desc: A flock of crows streams from foe to foe, a little weaker at each peck.

acts.name: Murder of Crows
acts.desc: Marks up to three foes (else ahead): a murder of crows dives on each a moment later, filling them with fear.

trait.blurb: Every third blow is a drumbeat: twice the rider and a shove.

extreme.name: Murmur Tympanum: The Death Drum
extreme.blurb: Three drumbeats roll out of the ground, each one a wider ring of ruin.

acts.name: Death Drum
acts.desc: A drumbeat you feel in your bones: foes round you are hurt, dizzied and thrown back.

acts.name: Funeral March
acts.desc: A slow funeral march: foes near you are drawn in, hurt, slowed and afraid.
